subject: S20 final (1d5b19c): 0031 single head, production player refuses loopback, comment fixed; live + matrix e2e green locally
body:
S20 final re-review items landed: 1d5b19c on claude/naadi-shared (after 8e5b86f, the 0031 rename). Full gate (lint, typecheck, vitest, pytest -m "not live and not db": 1580 passed) ran on this exact commit.

- Migration: 0031_s20_review.py (down 0030), single head (8e5b86f, already posted).
- review20 LOW (production player must not accept a loopback parent): deploy/player-space/player.js now ships `var ALLOW_LOOPBACK = false;`; with it off, only https://arrowassassin-naadi.hf.space is accepted. The development switch exists only in COPIES: the e2e matrix (video.spec) and the live spec replace that one line in the file they serve. scripts/deploy_player_space.sh refuses to upload a player.js whose line is not `false`. Redeployed with HF_TOKEN from env and verified (served sha matches, CSP present).
  - Tests: playerPage.test.ts loads the file as deployed and asserts loopback parents (localhost, 127.0.0.1, https and ::1 variants) are refused by allowedParent AND by trustedParent even when the loopback page really is the embedder; a dev copy accepts loopback but still refuses look-alike hosts; the source guard line is asserted.
  - Live (E2E_LIVE_YOUTUBE=1, chromium, real network, passed): test 1 serves the repo's files at the player origin with loopback on and drives REAL YouTube (ready, plays, fullscreen enabled in the nested embed, speed, seek); test 2 loads the DEPLOYED Space from this loopback app and checks it stays silent: no controls, nothing requested from youtube/ytimg.
- Comment fixed (bridge.ts): allow-presentation is left out because WebKit rejects it as an invalid sandbox flag (console error); Chromium accepts it; fullscreen does not need it.
- Stubbed matrix (video + anki + csp specs; webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440; --retries=0): 72/72, twice in a row, on the final build.
CI for 1d5b19c will be at https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions (queued when I last looked, so not yet seen green); I will keep watching and fix anything of mine.
